rationale.consistency: What exists follows v6 conventions (CheckResponse, closeResponse, errUnknown, 409 fallback mirrors UploadTest); envconfig `ignored` tag is the right mechanism.
rationale.edge_cases: Only the 409 create-or-find path is handled; no provisioning client, so 401/403 typing, no-upload-URL, poll-until-initializing and error-code mapping are all absent.
rationale.scope: Delivers a small fraction of the requirement: no provisioning package, no cmd-layer flow, no cloud output push-URL/HTTP-client injection, no notify; most listed tests cannot compile.
rationale.readability: Clear names and useful comments on the new config fields and fake server; nothing confusing in the code that is present.
rationale.robustness: Fake server panics on encode failure (acceptable in test helper); v6 helper handles nil response, but the missing orchestration means no real failure handling exists.
rationale.maintainability: clientcfg extraction avoids duplication and fake server is reusable, but the delivered pieces are disconnected stubs with no consumer, leaving the design unproven.
